backend/main.mo: Motoko backend defining profiles, posts, comments, and follow data with CRUD operations for posts, likes, comments, and profiles.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping implemented features to source files, components, tests, and confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing the purpose of each frontend file in the project.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind and CSS variables defining the app’s color theme and base styles for light and dark modes.
frontend/index.html: Entry HTML document loading the frontend root and main TypeScript bundle.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Sets up TanStack Router routes and wraps the app with layout, theme provider, and toaster notifications.
frontend/src/components/auth/RequireAuth: Auth guard component that prompts users to sign in before accessing protected content.
frontend/src/components/branding/Logo.ts: Simple logo component rendering the app’s logo image.
frontend/src/components/comments/Comment: Comments UI panel for viewing, adding, and deleting comments with authentication checks and profile linking.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: Defines the main application layout with navigation, authentication actions, header, footer, and content wrapper.
frontend/src/components/posts/LikeButton: Renders a like button that toggles like/unlike on a post with authentication and mutation handling.
frontend/src/components/posts/PostCard.t: Displays a post with author info, image, caption, like button, and comments, loading profile data as needed.
frontend/src/components/profile/Avatar.t: Shows a user avatar using an image URL or fallback icon with configurable sizing.
frontend/src/components/profile/FollowBu: Implements follow/unfollow actions with authentication checks and feedback to the user.
frontend/src/components/search/SearchRes: Displays a search result row linking to a user profile with avatar, name, and optional bio.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to the user's identity and refreshes dependent queries on change.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides authentication state, identity loading, login, and logout using Internet Identity.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for profiles, posts, likes, comments, and related mutations using the actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Sets global Tailwind styles, theme variables, typography, and color tokens for light and dark modes.
frontend/src/lib/imageValidation.ts: Validates uploaded images for type and size, ensuring they meet allowed constraints.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Initializes the app root with React Query and Internet Identity providers and loads global styles.
frontend/src/pages/ComposePostPage.tsx: Form page for creating a post with image upload, preview, validation, and progress tracking.
frontend/src/pages/EditProfilePage.tsx: Profile editing page allowing users to update display name, bio, and avatar image.
frontend/src/pages/FeedPage.tsx: Displays the main feed with optional following-only filter, showing posts or skeletons while loading.
frontend/src/pages/ProfilePage.tsx: Shows a user's profile, their posts, follow button, and auto-redirects owner to profile setup if missing.
frontend/src/pages/SearchPage.tsx: User search page with live query input and result list or loading skeletons.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending theme colors, fonts, animations, and enabling plugins.
project_state.json: Defines project state, required images, and a list of implemented features for an Instagram‑like app.
